messages.subject: Changes to Whatif List
messages.body_plain:
Hello users of WhatIf ,

We are moving the discussion of this mailing list to our Github. For discussing WhatIf, asking questions, or suggesting features, please use our Github discussions, found at https://github.com/IQSS/WhatIf/discussions. To report any bugs, please fill out this form: https://github.com/IQSS/WhatIf/issues/new.

Thank you,

Zagreb Mukerjee
Research Data Scientist
IQSS
